# Remaining decisive positions not solved in the default 5-second budget.
# All outcomes are from the side-to-move perspective.
# Format: name;fen;expected;note
#
# Note values carry the test budget for each entry (plan3 tasks 5.3/5.5):
#   solvable_evals:<B>  — must solve to the expected outcome within B child
#                         evaluations (deterministic, slow tier; B = 3× the
#                         measured first-outcome effort, rounded up).
#   unproven_evals:<B>  — must stay unproven within B child evaluations
#                         (deterministic, fast tier; B = 1,000,000, far below
#                         any known solve effort for these positions).
#   solvable_60s / unproven_60s — legacy wall-clock 60 s budgets; no entry
#                         currently uses them. Re-categorized entries should
#                         move between the note kinds; the matching test
#                         runners live in tests/test_decisive_remaining.rs.
#
